Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.

title: Here's a recap of the biggest changes!

author: Ubisoft
description:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2's new season, "Red Horizon," launches August 27.

The Cleaners have arrived in Washington D.C. for the first time, searching for the resources needed to fuel their signature Purple Flame. As smoke and fire spread across the city, Agents must rally together to stop the assault before the capital burns to the ground.

This season introduces the Blackout Dark Zone, a new uncapped PvP experience where Prototype Gear can be used at full power. The Toxic PvE Dark Zone also becomes a permanent part of the rotation, featuring additional rewards and new surprises arriving later in the season.

Build diversity takes center stage with gear and brand set balancing updates, while the new Under Pressure seasonal modifier rewards aggressive play with powerful bonuses and fire-focused gameplay. Agents can also earn new gear and weapons, including the Ember Engine Gear Set, the Fafnir Exotic Shotgun, the Iron Will Exotic Chest, and more.

title: The Division 2: Red Horizon Season - Dev Diary
